dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.reading: Xiǎonán, zhèlǐ yǒu shān, yě yǒu hú!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.reading: Shān shang yǒu hěn duō shù, hěn hǎokàn!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.reading: Nǐ jiā nàlǐ yǒu shān ma?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 没有。我家那里人很多，树很少。
dialogue.reading: Méiyǒu. Wǒ jiā nàlǐ rén hěn duō, shù hěn shǎo.
